name: std-market-board-3d
description: 3D single-hero market-service board FRAME: composes hero-nav (hero movement) + patience (stationary customers + starve timers) + fx-particles + market-flow (win/lose) onto one shared GameState with a single render authority. Games consume this molecule and supply only theme/assets/units/customers via config.

schema.name: std-market-board-3d
schema.description: 3D single-hero market-service board FRAME: composes hero-nav (hero movement) + patience (stationary customers + starve timers) + fx-particles + market-flow (win/lose) onto one shared GameState with a single render authority. Games consume this molecule and supply only theme/assets/units/customers via config.

emits.description: Hero moved onto tile (x,z) with movesLeft remaining; objective mechanics listen to score progress and round-flow to decide win/lose

events.name: Hero Stepped
events.description: Hero moved onto tile (x,z) with movesLeft remaining; objective mechanics listen to score progress and round-flow to decide win/lose

tiles.label: Tiles
tiles.description: Grid tiles used for passability checks (auto-generated all-passable when empty)

gridWidth.label: Grid Width
gridWidth.description: Grid column count clamping move + wander bounds

units.label: Initial Units
units.description: Seed roster: the player hero plus any neutral NPCs

moveBudget.label: Move Budget
moveBudget.description: Moves the hero may spend before the round is lost if objectives remain

running.label: Running
running.description: When true, MOVE/WANDER intents are applied; toggle to freeze the board

gridHeight.label: Grid Height
gridHeight.description: Grid row count clamping move + wander bounds

emits.description: Serve or starve particle burst; a fx-particles listener spawns it
Served/pending/lost counts after this step; a market-flow listener decides win/lose
Emitted when one or more customers' patience expires in the same tick

events.name: Burst
events.description: Serve or starve particle burst; a fx-particles listener spawns it

events.name: Service Changed
events.description: Served/pending/lost counts after this step; a market-flow listener decides win/lose

events.name: Customer Lost
events.description: Emitted when one or more customers' patience expires in the same tick

customers.label: Customers
customers.description: Seed roster of stationary customers, each with their own position + patience/maxPatience

serveRadius.label: Serve Radius
serveRadius.description: Manhattan distance at which a customer counts as served by the hero's last step: 0 = step onto tile, 1 = adjacent

running.label: Running
running.description: When true, patience ticks down and HERO_STEPPED serves nearby customers; toggle to freeze

fx.label: Initial Fx
fx.description: Seed particles rendered before the first BURST; usually empty.

decayRate.label: Decay Rate
decayRate.description: Ttl units removed from every fx entry each tick; higher fades particles faster.

running.label: Running
running.description: When true the decay tick runs; toggle to freeze effects.

emits.description: Emitted when result becomes won or lost

events.name: Game End
events.description: Emitted when result becomes won or lost

maxLost.label: Max Lost
maxLost.description: Cumulative starved-customer count that ends the round in a loss

running.label: Running
running.description: When true, SERVICE_CHANGED signals resolve win/lose; toggle to freeze

targetServed.label: Target Served
targetServed.description: Cumulative customers served needed to win

events.description: Hero move intent applied by the hero-nav authority

events.name: Restart
events.description: Resets every mechanic (units/budget, customers/patience, result) for a new round

  trait Patience = Svc.traits.Patience -> GameState {
    config {
      running: true
      serveRadius: 1
      customers: [
        { id: "cust-1", position: { x: 2, y: 2 }, patience: 10, maxPatience: 10, unitType: "customer", name: "Customer", team: "customer", modelUrl: { url: "https://almadar-kflow-assets.web.app/shared/_shared/kenney-shape-characters/units/spritesheet_default.png", atlas: "https://almadar-kflow-assets.web.app/shared/_shared/kenney-shape-characters/units/spritesheet_default.json", sprite: "red_body_square.png", role: "customer", category: "customer", animations: ["idle"], style: "vector", dimension: "2d", aspect: "1:1", name: "customer", thumbnailUrl: "" } }
      ]
    }
  }

  trait FxDecay = Particles.traits.FxParticles -> GameState {
    config { running: true }
  }

  trait RoundGate = Flow.traits.MarketFlow -> GameState {
    config { running: true, targetServed: 10, maxLost: 3 }
  }

  trait MarketIntent -> GameState [interaction, instance] {
    initial: playing

    state playing {
      INIT -> playing
        (set @entity.selectedUnitId "")
        (set @entity.validMoves [])
        (set @entity.phase "observation")
        (render-ui main {
          type: game-shell
          hud: { type: game-hud, stats: [ { label: @config.scoreLabel, value: @entity.served }, { label: @config.livesLabel, value: (- @config.maxLost @entity.lost) }, { label: "Result", value: @entity.result }, { label: "Goal", value: @config.goalText }, { label: "How", value: @config.howText } ] }
          addons: { type: stack, direction: vertical, gap: sm, children: [ { type: button, action: CANCEL, label: "Cancel", variant: secondary }, { type: button, action: PLAY_AGAIN, label: "Restart", variant: secondary } ] }
          overlay: (if (!= @entity.result "none") { type: stack, direction: vertical, gap: md, align: center, children: [ { type: game-hud, stats: [ { label: "Result", value: @entity.result } ] }, { type: button, action: PLAY_AGAIN, label: "Play Again", variant: primary } ] } null)
          children: [ { type: canvas, mode: "3d", camera: { mode: @config.cameraMode, zoom: @config.scale }, tileClickEvent: TILE_CLICK, unitClickEvent: UNIT_CLICK, unitScale: @config.unitScale, backgroundColor: @config.bgColor, children: [
            { type: draw-sprite-layer, items: (array/filter (array/map @entity.tiles (fn t { type: draw-sprite, position: { x: (object/get @t x), y: (object/get @t y), z: (object/get @t z) }, asset: (if (object/get (object/get @t modelUrl) url) (object/get @t modelUrl) (object/get (object/get @config.assetManifest terrains) (object/get @t terrain))) })) (fn s (object/get (object/get @s asset) url))) }
            { type: draw-sprite-layer, items: (array/map @config.features (fn f { type: draw-sprite, position: { x: (object/get @f x), y: (object/get @f y) }, asset: (object/get @f assetUrl) })) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/map @entity.validMoves (fn m { type: draw-shape, shape: "cell", position: { x: (object/get @m x), y: (object/get @m z) }, fill: "rgba(74,222,128,0.4)" })) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/map (array/filter @entity.units (fn u (== (object/get @u id) @entity.selectedUnitId))) (fn u { type: draw-shape, shape: "ellipse", position: { x: (object/get (object/get @u position) x), y: (object/get (object/get @u position) y), z: (object/get @u z) }, radiusX: 0.5, radiusY: 0.2, stroke: "rgba(0,200,255,0.8)", strokeWidth: 3 })) }
            { type: draw-sprite-layer, items: (array/concat (array/map @entity.units (fn u { type: draw-sprite, position: { x: (object/get (object/get @u position) x), y: (object/get (object/get @u position) y), z: (object/get @u z) }, asset: (object/get @u modelUrl), id: (object/get @u id), width: 0.8, height: 0.8, anchor: "ground" })) (array/map @entity.customers (fn c { type: draw-sprite, position: (object/get @c position), asset: (object/get @c modelUrl), width: 0.8, height: 0.8 }))) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/concat (array/map @entity.units (fn u { type: draw-shape, shape: "rect", position: { x: (object/get (object/get @u position) x), y: (object/get (object/get @u position) y), z: (object/get @u z) }, offsetY: -0.6, width: 0.8, height: 0.12, fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)" })) (array/map @entity.customers (fn c { type: draw-shape, shape: "rect", position: (object/get @c position), offsetY: -0.6, width: 0.8, height: 0.12, fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)" }))) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/concat (array/map @entity.units (fn u { type: draw-shape, shape: "rect", position: { x: (object/get (object/get @u position) x), y: (object/get (object/get @u position) y), z: (object/get @u z) }, offsetY: -0.6, width: (* 0.8 (/ (object/get @u health) (object/get @u maxHealth))), height: 0.12, fill: "#22c55e" })) (array/map @entity.customers (fn c { type: draw-shape, shape: "rect", position: (object/get @c position), offsetY: -0.6, width: 0.8, height: 0.12, fill: "#22c55e" }))) }
            { type: draw-text-layer, items: (array/concat (array/map @entity.units (fn u { type: draw-text, text: (object/get @u name), position: { x: (object/get (object/get @u position) x), y: (object/get (object/get @u position) y), z: (object/get @u z) }, offsetY: -0.85, color: "#ffffff" })) (array/map @entity.customers (fn c { type: draw-text, text: (object/get @c name), position: (object/get @c position), offsetY: -0.85, color: "#ffffff" }))) }
            { type: draw-fx-layer, items: @entity.fx, tickMs: 500, presets: @config.fxPresets }
          ] } ]
        })

      UNIT_CLICK -> playing when (and (== @entity.result "none") (== (object/get (array/find @entity.units (fn u (== @u.id ?unitId))) team) "player"))
        (set @entity.selectedUnitId ?unitId)
        (set @entity.phase "selection")
        (set @entity.validMoves (array/map (array/filter @entity.tiles (fn t (and (== (object/get @t passable) true) (and (<= (grid/manhattan-distance (object/get (array/find @entity.units (fn u (== @u.id ?unitId))) position) { x: (object/get @t x), y: (object/get @t y) }) @config.movementRange) (and (== (array/len (array/filter @entity.units (fn u (and (== (object/get (object/get @u position) x) (object/get @t x)) (== (object/get (object/get @u position) y) (object/get @t y)))))) 0) (== (array/len (array/filter @entity.customers (fn c (and (== (object/get (object/get @c position) x) (object/get @t x)) (== (object/get (object/get @c position) y) (object/get @t y)))))) 0)))))) (fn t { x: (object/get @t x), z: (object/get @t y) })))

      TILE_CLICK -> playing when (and (== @entity.result "none") (and (!= @entity.selectedUnitId "") (and (grid/in-bounds { x: ?x, y: ?z } @config.gridWidth @config.gridHeight) (and (<= (grid/manhattan-distance (object/get (array/find @entity.units (fn u (== @u.id @entity.selectedUnitId))) position) { x: ?x, y: ?z }) @config.movementRange) (and (== (object/get (array/find @entity.tiles (fn t (and (== (object/get @t x) ?x) (== (object/get @t y) ?z)))) passable) true) (and (== (array/len (array/filter @entity.units (fn u (and (== (object/get (object/get @u position) x) ?x) (== (object/get (object/get @u position) y) ?z))))) 0) (== (array/len (array/filter @entity.customers (fn c (and (== (object/get (object/get @c position) x) ?x) (== (object/get (object/get @c position) y) ?z))))) 0)))))))
        (emit MOVE { unitId: @entity.selectedUnitId, x: ?x, y: ?z })
        (set @entity.selectedUnitId "")
        (set @entity.validMoves [])
        (set @entity.phase "observation")

      CANCEL -> playing when (!= @entity.selectedUnitId "")
        (set @entity.selectedUnitId "")
        (set @entity.validMoves [])
        (set @entity.phase "observation")

      PLAY_AGAIN -> playing
        (emit RESTART { id: "board" })
        (set @entity.selectedUnitId "")
        (set @entity.validMoves [])
        (set @entity.phase "observation")
    }

    ticks {
      renderTick every 100ms
        (render-ui main {
          type: game-shell
          hud: { type: game-hud, stats: [ { label: @config.scoreLabel, value: @entity.served }, { label: @config.livesLabel, value: (- @config.maxLost @entity.lost) }, { label: "Result", value: @entity.result }, { label: "Goal", value: @config.goalText }, { label: "How", value: @config.howText } ] }
          addons: { type: stack, direction: vertical, gap: sm, children: [ { type: button, action: CANCEL, label: "Cancel", variant: secondary }, { type: button, action: PLAY_AGAIN, label: "Restart", variant: secondary } ] }
          overlay: (if (!= @entity.result "none") { type: stack, direction: vertical, gap: md, align: center, children: [ { type: game-hud, stats: [ { label: "Result", value: @entity.result } ] }, { type: button, action: PLAY_AGAIN, label: "Play Again", variant: primary } ] } null)
          children: [ { type: canvas, mode: "3d", camera: { mode: @config.cameraMode, zoom: @config.scale }, tileClickEvent: TILE_CLICK, unitClickEvent: UNIT_CLICK, unitScale: @config.unitScale, backgroundColor: @config.bgColor, children: [
            { type: draw-sprite-layer, items: (array/filter (array/map @entity.tiles (fn t { type: draw-sprite, position: { x: (object/get @t x), y: (object/get @t y), z: (object/get @t z) }, asset: (if (object/get (object/get @t modelUrl) url) (object/get @t modelUrl) (object/get (object/get @config.assetManifest terrains) (object/get @t terrain))) })) (fn s (object/get (object/get @s asset) url))) }
            { type: draw-sprite-layer, items: (array/map @config.features (fn f { type: draw-sprite, position: { x: (object/get @f x), y: (object/get @f y) }, asset: (object/get @f assetUrl) })) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/map @entity.validMoves (fn m { type: draw-shape, shape: "cell", position: { x: (object/get @m x), y: (object/get @m z) }, fill: "rgba(74,222,128,0.4)" })) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/map (array/filter @entity.units (fn u (== (object/get @u id) @entity.selectedUnitId))) (fn u { type: draw-shape, shape: "ellipse", position: { x: (object/get (object/get @u position) x), y: (object/get (object/get @u position) y), z: (object/get @u z) }, radiusX: 0.5, radiusY: 0.2, stroke: "rgba(0,200,255,0.8)", strokeWidth: 3 })) }
            { type: draw-sprite-layer, items: (array/concat (array/map @entity.units (fn u { type: draw-sprite, position: { x: (object/get (object/get @u position) x), y: (object/get (object/get @u position) y), z: (object/get @u z) }, asset: (object/get @u modelUrl), id: (object/get @u id), width: 0.8, height: 0.8, anchor: "ground" })) (array/map @entity.customers (fn c { type: draw-sprite, position: (object/get @c position), asset: (object/get @c modelUrl), width: 0.8, height: 0.8 }))) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/concat (array/map @entity.units (fn u { type: draw-shape, shape: "rect", position: { x: (object/get (object/get @u position) x), y: (object/get (object/get @u position) y), z: (object/get @u z) }, offsetY: -0.6, width: 0.8, height: 0.12, fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)" })) (array/map @entity.customers (fn c { type: draw-shape, shape: "rect", position: (object/get @c position), offsetY: -0.6, width: 0.8, height: 0.12, fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.6)" }))) }
            { type: draw-shape-layer, items: (array/concat (array/map @entity.units (fn u { type: draw-shape, shape: "rect", position: { x: (object/get (object/get @u position) x), y: (object/get (object/get @u position) y), z: (object/get @u z) }, offsetY: -0.6, width: (* 0.8 (/ (object/get @u health) (object/get @u maxHealth))), height: 0.12, fill: "#22c55e" })) (array/map @entity.customers (fn c { type: draw-shape, shape: "rect", position: (object/get @c position), offsetY: -0.6, width: 0.8, height: 0.12, fill: "#22c55e" }))) }
            { type: draw-text-layer, items: (array/concat (array/map @entity.units (fn u { type: draw-text, text: (object/get @u name), position: { x: (object/get (object/get @u position) x), y: (object/get (object/get @u position) y), z: (object/get @u z) }, offsetY: -0.85, color: "#ffffff" })) (array/map @entity.customers (fn c { type: draw-text, text: (object/get @c name), position: (object/get @c position), offsetY: -0.85, color: "#ffffff" }))) }
            { type: draw-fx-layer, items: @entity.fx, tickMs: 500, presets: @config.fxPresets }
          ] } ]
        })
    }

    emits {
      MOVE -> external {
        unitId : string!
        x : number!
        y : number!
      }
        @description "Hero move intent applied by the hero-nav authority"
        @tier "domain"
      RESTART -> external {
        id : string!
      }
        @description "Resets every mechanic (units/budget, customers/patience, result) for a new round"
        @tier "domain"
      TILE_CLICK -> external {
        x : number!
        z : number!
        tileId : string
      }
        @description "tileClickEvent prop"
        @tier "domain"
      UNIT_CLICK -> external {
        unitId : string!
        x : number
        z : number
      }
        @description "unitClickEvent prop"
        @tier "domain"
      CANCEL -> external {
        id : string
      }
        @description "Clears the current selection"
        @tier "domain"
    }

    config {
      gridWidth : number = 4
        @label "Grid Width"
        @description "Grid column count (matches HeroAuthority.gridWidth)."
        @tier "presentation"
      gridHeight : number = 4
        @label "Grid Height"
        @description "Grid row count (matches HeroAuthority.gridHeight)."
        @tier "presentation"
      movementRange : number = 1
        @label "Movement Range"
        @description "Max manhattan distance the hero may step per move."
        @tier "domain"
      scoreLabel : string = "Score"
        @label "Score Label"
        @description "HUD label for the served/score counter."
        @tier "presentation"
      livesLabel : string = "Lives"
        @label "Lives Label"
        @description "HUD label for the remaining-lives counter (maxLost - lost)."
        @tier "presentation"
      maxLost : number = 3
        @label "Max Lost"
        @description "Starting lives shown in the HUD (matches RoundGate.maxLost)."
        @tier "presentation"
      goalText : string = "Serve customers before their patience runs out"
        @label "Goal Text"
        @description "HUD goal description."
        @tier "presentation"
      howText : string = "Walk next to a customer — they are served automatically while you're adjacent"
        @label "How Text"
        @description "HUD how-to-play description."
        @tier "presentation"
      cameraMode : string = "top-down"
        @label "Camera Mode"
        @description "3D canvas camera mode."
        @tier "presentation"
      scale : number = 0.45
        @label "Scale"
        @description "Canvas render scale."
        @tier "presentation"
      unitScale : number = 1
        @label "Unit Scale"
        @description "Unit draw-size multiplier."
        @tier "presentation"
      bgColor : string = "#0a0f1a"
        @label "Bg Color"
        @description "Canvas background color."
        @tier "presentation"
      features : [Feature] = []
        @label "Features"
        @description "Static decorative props (shelves/freezers/checkout/etc); never mutated by any mechanic."
        @tier "presentation"
      fxPresets : [FxPreset] = [ { type: "score", color: "#fbbf24", color2: "#fde68a", size: 0.45, shape: "spark", count: 6, glow: 0.1, vy: -0.3 }, { type: "damage", color: "#ef4444", color2: "#450a0a", size: 0.5, shape: "puff", count: 4, gravity: 0.3 } ]
        @label "Fx Presets"
        @description "This board's effect vocabulary — one look/recipe row per fx type its mechanics emit; unknown types fall back to a neutral spark."
        @tier "presentation"
      assetManifest : AssetManifest = { terrains: {}, units: {}, features: {}, effects: {} }
        @label "Asset Manifest"
        @description "Per-role model manifest resolving tile models by terrain key."
        @tier "presentation"
    }
  }

  page "/market-board-3d" as MarketBoard3DPage -> HeroAuthority, Patience, FxDecay, RoundGate, MarketIntent
}
